definitions.explanation: An ornamental piece of jewelry worn on or around the ear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耳飾|みみかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{耳飾|みみかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received earrings from my mother for my birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耳飾|みみかざ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That museum has ancient gold earrings on display.

notes:
A native Japanese word (⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ ear + ⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧ ornament) that covers all types of ear jewelry. In modern everyday speech, the loanwords ⟦ピアス→ピアス：04685_piasu⟧ (pierced earring) and ⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧ (clip-on earring) are far more common. {耳飾|みみかざ}り appears more often in literary, historical, or formal descriptive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳飾|みみかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ — put on earrings
- {耳飾|みみかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ — take off earrings
- {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耳飾|みみかざ}り — gold earrings
- ⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耳飾|みみかざ}り — pearl earrings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ピアス→ピアス：04685_piasu⟧ — pierced earring; the standard everyday word for earrings worn through pierced ears
- ⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧ — clip-on earring; in Japanese, this specifically means the clip-on type, unlike English where "earring" is general
- イヤーカフ — ear cuff; a newer fashion term for earrings that clip onto the ear cartilage
